title: A clone that runs the kb-sprint skill's coordination settings init fails its own test suite and push gate
goal: A clone whose root settings.json holds a coordination object, as kbsettings.py init writes it when the kb-sprint skill first runs, passes _tools/test_redact.py's kb_settings assertion and so the sync push gate: the test reads a planted workspace, not the clone's real root

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
C = os.path.join(T, 'clone')
try:
    subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '-q', '--local', '.', C], check=True, timeout=900)
    i = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbsettings.py', 'init', '--root', '.', '--set', 'strategy.landing=ask'],
                       cwd=C, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    assert i.returncode == 0, ('kbsettings init', i.returncode, i.stderr[-300:])
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/tests.py', '-k', 'kb_feedback_spools_one_closed_row'],
                       cwd=C, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0 and 'source: settings.json' not in (p.stdout + p.stderr), ('a clone that ran the sprint skill settings init fails its own test suite', (p.stdout + p.stderr)[-700:])

clauses.clause: A clone whose root settings.json holds a coordination object, as kbsettings.py init writes it when the kb-sprint skill first runs, passes _tools/test_redact.py's kb_settings assertion and so the sync push gate: the test reads a planted workspace, not the clone's real root

notes: From the retrospective of SP-3qowbedb; the operator accepted it at the close. Once this lands, the orchestrator writes the operator's coordination answers of 2026-10-26 as the clone's local, uncommitted settings.json: python3 _tools/kbsettings.py init --root . --set announce.when=start,claim --set strategy.decide=operator --set strategy.landing=ask --set strategy.working=ask, and puts backlog.json back as tracked (kb/_self/maintaining.md, Setup); then a push gate run shows the file no longer trips it. In this kb clone the skill's init step leaves backlog.json's hooks list as tracked (kb/_self/maintaining.md, Setup); the skill text says so where it runs init.
